tools.name: codex
tools.description: Execute Codex CLI in non-interactive mode for AI assistance

prompt.description: The coding task, question, or analysis request

sessionId.description: Optional session ID for conversational context. Note: when resuming a session, sandbox/fullAuto/workingDirectory parameters are not applied (CLI limitation)

resetSession.description: Reset the session history before processing this request

model.description: Specify which model to use (defaults to gpt-5.3-codex). Options: gpt-5.3-codex, gpt-5.2-codex, gpt-5.1-codex, gpt-5.1-codex-max, gpt-5-codex, gpt-4o, gpt-4, o3, o4-mini

reasoningEffort.description: Control reasoning depth (none < minimal < low < medium < high < xhigh)

sandbox.description: Sandbox policy for shell command execution. read-only: no writes allowed, workspace-write: writes only in workspace, danger-full-access: full system access (dangerous)

fullAuto.description: Enable full-auto mode: sandboxed automatic execution without approval prompts (equivalent to -a on-request --sandbox workspace-write)

workingDirectory.description: Working directory for the agent to use as its root (passed via -C flag)

callbackUri.description: Static MCP callback URI to pass to Codex via environment (if provided)

tools.name: review
tools.description: Run a code review against the current repository using Codex CLI

prompt.description: Custom review instructions or focus areas (cannot be used with uncommitted=true; use base/commit review instead)

uncommitted.description: Review staged, unstaged, and untracked changes (working tree) - cannot be combined with custom prompt

base.description: Review changes against a specific base branch (e.g., "main", "develop")

commit.description: Review the changes introduced by a specific commit SHA

title.description: Optional title to display in the review summary

model.description: Specify which model to use for the review (defaults to gpt-5.3-codex)

workingDirectory.description: Working directory to run the review in (passed via -C as a global Codex option)

tools.name: listSessions
tools.description: List all active conversation sessions with metadata

tools.name: websearch
tools.description: Perform web search using Codex CLI with web search enabled

numResults.description: Number of search results to return (1-50, default: 10)

searchDepth.description: Search depth: basic (faster) or full (deeper analysis, default: basic)
